act: Arrêté du 13 juin 2025 (bonification BAR-TH-174/175)
content: Rénovation d'ampleur CEE bonus for modest households set as multiplier: x4 for operations claimed by ANAH, x2 otherwise.
ne_note: Raises CEE value folded into MPR accompagné for modest households.

act: Arrêté du 18 août 2025 (modalités)
content: Biomass Coup de pouce (BAR-TH-113 boilers, BAR-TH-112 stoves) switched from minimum EUR amounts to a multiplier coefficient; minimum incentive requirement dropped. Absorption / gas-engine heat-pump bonuses abolished from 2025-09-01.

act: Arrêté du 6 septembre 2025 (BAR-TH-171/172 + Coup de pouce)
content: Heat-pump Coup de pouce becomes coefficient x5 for operations engaged 2025-10-01 to 2030-12-31, regardless of income; minimum EUR incentive (4,000/2,500) dropped; second homes excluded. Fiches revised.
ne_note: Large increase in CEE support for air/water and ground-source heat pumps, all incomes, from 2025-10-01: coincides with MPR reopening (2025-09-30).

act: Arrêté du 6 septembre 2025 (collective heat pumps / geothermal)
content: BAR-TH-166 and BAT-TH-113 abolished; new BAR-TH-178 (geothermal system), BAR-TH-179/180 (collective air/water, water/water heat pumps) and tertiary equivalents, with new bonuses.

act: Décret 2025-1048 du 30 octobre 2025 (sixième période) + Arrêté du 21 décembre 2025 (JORFTEXT000053158200)
content: Start of the 6th CEE period (2026-2030). Arrêté: Coup de pouce available without signing the charter for non-obligated parties acting on own assets; inspection-body accreditation rules; fuel-oil coefficient updated. Obligation level not checked here.
status: partly verified (arrêté notice; décret title only)
ne_note: Obligation level drives CEE prices and hence private top-ups: check the 6th-period volume.

act: Arrêté du 15 décembre 2025 (BAR-TH-171/172)
content: Heat-pump fiches and a bonus criterion revised; on-site control rates raised.

act: Décret 2025-1293 + Arrêté du 29 décembre 2025 (mandataires)
content: Framework for fund-collecting mandataires extended to all ANAH private-housing aids (financial guarantees, probity, restitution of undue aid).

act: No budget (loi de finances 2026 not adopted)
content: MPR application window closed for all parcours from 2026-01-01; reopened 2026-02-23 after promulgation of loi de finances 2026 (loi 2026-103 du 19 février 2026). 2026 MPR budget about EUR 3.6bn (target 120k accompagné + 150k par geste).
ne_note: Seven-week suspension of all MPR filing (after the summer-2025 accompagné suspension): timing shock; look for bunching before 2026-01-01 and catch-up after 2026-02-23.

act: Décret 2025-956 + Arrêté 8 sept. 2025 (re-enacted by Décret 2026-516 + Arrêté 12 juin 2026)
content: Wall insulation and biomass boilers removed from par geste for applications from 2026-01-01 (already in main table). Both texts re-enacted in June 2026 with the missing countersignatures, after Conseil d'État n°501151 (2026-03-11) annulled the 2024 biomass cut on that ground.
ne_note: Legal-certainty fix; no change in substance.

act: Arrêté du 20 février 2026 (re-enacted by Arrêté du 11 juin 2026)
content: Parcours accompagné: attestation of a prior visit to a France Rénov' guichet required before filing (applications from 2026-01-01).
ne_note: Added procedural step for accompagné; possible effect on take-up / selection.

act: Arrêté du 10 juin 2026
content: Re-enacts the 2025 biomass forfait cut (annulled by CE 501151) for applications filed 2025-01-01..2025-12-31.
ne_note: Resolves the uncertainty flagged in the main table (2025-01-01 row): cut values apply to 2025 applications.

act: Loi de finances 2026 art. 92 + Arrêté du 13 juillet 2026 (corr. 14 août 2026)
content: Reduced 5.5% VAT extended to air/air heat pumps meeting life-cycle environmental and durability criteria.
ne_note: Air/air heat pumps (not MPR-eligible) get a VAT cut: substitution margin vs air/water.

act: Arrêté du 17 août 2026 (BAR-TH-174/175 + Coup de pouce rénovation d'ampleur)
content: Rénovation d'ampleur CEE fiches restricted to dwellings rated E-G; BAR-TH-174 (houses) requires fully decarbonised heating and DHW after works; Coup de pouce refocused on social-housing houses not eligible for ANAH aid; cumulation rule based on completion date.
ne_note: Mirrors the MPR accompagné fossil exclusion of the same date.

act: Décret 2026-822 + Arrêté du 25 août 2026 (x2: forfaits + technical arrêté)
content: Par geste cut to essentially heating systems: forfaits removed for wood/biomass stoves and DHW, heat-pump water heaters (CET), ventilation, all insulation, solar thermal / hybrid panels (mainland). F/G access to par geste extended to 2027-12-31; DPE requirement postponed to 2028-01-01. Parcours accompagné (houses only): no project may install or keep any fossil-capable heating/DHW equipment (heat networks excepted); heat pumps with fossil back-up no longer fundable in MPR.
ne_note: Major par-geste contraction (insulation and CET exit) and fossil ban in accompagné for houses, applications from 2026-09-01: geste x time designs (e.g. CET vs heat pump, insulation exit).

act: Arrêté du 29 mai 2026 + Arrêté du 2 juillet 2026 (approved heat-pump list)
content: Heat-pump Coup de pouce (x5) reserved for heat pumps holding the industrial quality and resilience approval (list fixed by arrêté 2 July 2026, JO 5 July 2026); others keep base CEE only.
status: verified (notice of 29 May arrêté); list arrêté from secondary source
ne_note: Product-level eligibility shock for heat pumps (approved vs non-approved models).

act: Arrêté du 7 juillet 2026 (loi anti-fraude 2025-594 art. 14)
content: Any advertising for energy-renovation works must inform consumers of the France Rénov' public service, with a link for websites.
ne_note: Relevant to firms' outreach to customers.

act: Arrêté du 4 septembre 2026
content: Allows replacement of combustion equipment already claimed under CEE to be claimed again (conditions not read).

act: Arrêtés du 26 et 28 octobre 2026
content: 27 fiches abolished (incl. BAR-EN-110, BAR-SE-105, BAR-TH-122), and BAR-TH-168 (solar thermal) abolished.
ne_note: Solar thermal now out of both MPR par geste and CEE.

act: Arrêté du 5 novembre 2026 (précarité)
content: New definition of 'précarité énergétique' for CEE; residential and transport bonuses adapted; rénovation d'ampleur bonuses raised for precarious and other households.
ne_note: Changes which households count as precarious for CEE: compare with ANAH income categories.

act: Arrêté du 6 novembre 2026 (corr. 13 nov.)
content: Specific bonuses for ADEME-selected 'integrated heat-pump offers' under BAR-TH-171.
